# sc-tools

Pip-installable copy of the ASAP PMDBS sc/sn RNA-seq processing scripts from
[`sc-rnaseq-wf/docker/sc_tools`](https://github.com/ASAP-CRN/sc-rnaseq-wf/tree/main/docker/sc_tools).

**Do not edit `src/sc_tools/`, `requirements*.txt` or `entry-points.txt` by hand.** They are
regenerated by `sync.py`. Make changes upstream in `sc-rnaseq-wf`.

## Install

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/ASAP-CRN/sc-tools.git
pip install "sc-tools[mmc] @ git+https://github.com/ASAP-CRN/sc-tools.git"   # + Allen cell_type_mapper for sc-mmc
```

Dependencies are pinned to match the `sc_tools` Docker image. GPU builds of jax/torch need to be
installed separately, the same way the Dockerfile does.

## Usage

Each upstream script is a console command named `sc-<script-name>` (underscores become hyphens),
and each one takes the same arguments as the Docker version:

| upstream script             | command                        |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `prep_metadata`             | `sc-prep-metadata`             |
| `merge_and_plot_qc`         | `sc-merge-and-plot-qc`         |
| `filter`                    | `sc-filter`                    |
| `mmc`                       | `sc-mmc`                       |
| `process`                   | `sc-process`                   |
| `transcriptional_phenotype` | `sc-transcriptional-phenotype` |
| `integrate_scvi`            | `sc-integrate-scvi`            |
| `label_scanvi`              | `sc-label-scanvi`              |
| `clustering_umap`           | `sc-clustering-umap`           |
| `add_harmony`               | `sc-add-harmony`               |
| `artifact_metrics`          | `sc-artifact-metrics`          |
| `plot_groups_and_feats`     | `sc-plot-groups-and-feats`     |

You can also call them as modules (`python -m sc_tools.process ...`) or import them
(`from sc_tools.helpers import score_cell_cycle`).

## Syncing

```bash
python sync.py ../sc-rnaseq-wf    # path to a local sc-rnaseq-wf checkout
```

`sync.py` makes these changes to the upstream code:
- It copies `scripts/main/*` and `scripts/utility/helpers.py` to `src/sc_tools/*.py`.
- It replaces `sys.path.append("/opt/scripts/utility")` / `from helpers import` with `from sc_tools.helpers import`.
- It changes `/opt/resources/*.txt` paths to point at the copies bundled in the package.
- It wraps each `if __name__ == "__main__":` block in a `cli()` function so the script can be a console entry point.
- It takes the version from `build.env` (`SC_TOOLS_VERSION`) and records the upstream commit in `sc_tools.__upstream_commit__`.

The script stops with an error if the upstream code has a shape it doesn't recognise, for example
a new `/opt/` path.

`.github/workflows/sync.yml` runs the sync every week, on manual dispatch, or on a
`repository_dispatch` event of type `sc-tools-updated`. It opens a PR whenever the output changes.
